turns.question: Who was our best customer in September 2026, and how much did they spend?
turns.answer: Customer 3 was our best customer in September 2026 (1 to 30 September), with EUR 1,380.00 of revenue from non-cancelled orders over that period. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
